blurb: Jersey Shore Cruises offers party boat experiences including The Salty Palm, Cape May Party Cruises, and Wildwood Sip-n-Slide Pontoons. Guests can enjoy music, dancing, swimming, and bar hopping on the water. The boats accommodate groups from 10 to 49 passengers and are suitable for events like birthdays, bachelorette parties, and family outings.
